🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: weak overall sector breadth and narrow leadership concentrated in Technology (Top 5 performers = AMD, INTC, QCOM, PANW, LRCX → Leadership: Narrow (5/5 Technology)); major divergence across large caps (several megacaps and cyclicals showing mixed 1W vs 1M signals) suppresses a stronger regime call.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Technology leads: AMD (1W: +26.25% | 1M: +92.36%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +25.40% | 1M: +102.40%) ABOVE TREND, QCOM (1W: +23.77% | 1M: +71.50%) ABOVE TREND. Consumer Staples next: MNST (1W: +11.89% | 1M: +13.26%) ABOVE TREND, CVS (1W: +10.31% | 1M: +15.86%) ABOVE TREND. Consumer Discretionary showing pockets of strength: TSLA (1W: +9.60% | 1M: +23.94%) ABOVE TREND, BA (1W: +4.39% | 1M: +7.86%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Energy lagging: XOM (1W: -5.36% | 1M: -6.75%) BELOW TREND, CVX (1W: -4.73% | 1M: -4.59%) BELOW TREND. Utilities weak overall (sector 1W: -3.89%). Financials soft: JPM (1W: -3.32% | 1M: -2.65%) BELOW TREND, PYPL (1W: -10.05% | 1M: -1.33%) BELOW TREND.

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: AMD (1W: +26.25% | 1M: +92.36%) ABOVE TREND; INTC (1W: +25.40% | 1M: +102.40%) ABOVE TREND; QCOM (1W: +23.77% | 1M: +71.50%) ABOVE TREND; PANW (1W: +14.80% | 1M: +24.49%) ABOVE TREND; LRCX (1W: +14.54% | 1M: +13.64%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (5/5 Technology). Style: mixed / no clear leadership given weak breadth.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: SLB (1W: -6.41% | 1M: +1.39%) TREND EXHAUSTION; EOG (1W: -6.42% | 1M: -4.06%) BELOW TREND; CMCSA (1W: -6.58% | 1M: -10.28%) BELOW TREND; COP (1W: -7.57% | 1M: -7.78%) BELOW TREND; SHOP (1W: -13.52% | 1M: -1.75%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in Energy and select Communications names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Top 1W movers: AMD (1W: +26.25% | 1M: +92.36%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +25.40% | 1M: +102.40%) ABOVE TREND, QCOM (1W: +23.77% | 1M: +71.50%) ABOVE TREND. Major divergence flagged (≥3 large caps with conflicting 1W vs 1M signals) — treat moves as tactical momentum, watch for snapbacks.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Technology is the clear short-term driver (1W: +6.30% | 1M: +21.99%; 24 stocks); AAPL (1W: +4.70% | 1M: +12.60%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +0.16% | 1M: +11.27%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +8.44% | 1M: +17.01%) ABOVE TREND, SHOP (1W: -13.52% | 1M: -1.75%) BELOW TREND. Breadth internally is uneven and leadership is concentrated in semis/AI-related names.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials are lagging (1W: -2.18% | 1M: -0.64%; 20 stocks); JPM (1W: -3.32% | 1M: -2.65%) BELOW TREND, V (1W: -2.82% | 1M: +3.41%) TREND EXHAUSTION, MA (1W: +0.00% | 1M: -1.61%) NEUTRAL. Sector weakness reduces conviction for broad financial exposure; monitor earnings and credit headlines.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare under pressure (1W: -1.00% | 1M: -4.63%; 17 stocks); UNH (1W: +3.04% | 1M: +23.81%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: -2.58% | 1M: -8.28%) BELOW TREND, LLY (1W: -1.54% | 1M: -0.71%) BELOW TREND. Sentiment catalysts (UNH, BMY) are concentrated but broad sector shows softness.

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Remain selective in a NEUTRAL regime; favor selective technology semiconductors and chip-equipment exposure (AMD, INTC, LRCX) while reducing exposure to cyclic energy names and idiosyncratic weak Financials (PYPL, JPM under pressure). Monitor major divergence and news catalysts before adding to broad sector positions.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: AMD (1W: +26.25% | 1M: +92.36%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +25.40% | 1M: +102.40%) ABOVE TREND, QCOM (1W: +23.77% | 1M: +71.50%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: PYPL (1W: -10.05% | 1M: -1.33%) BELOW TREND, XOM (1W: -5.36% | 1M: -6.75%) BELOW TREND, CHTR (1W: -9.83% | 1M: -30.63%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Technology (1W: +6.30%) — monitor whether semiconductor strength broadens. BEARISH: Energy (1W: -5.04%) and Financials (1W: -2.18%) — watch for downside follow-through or stabilization.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NVDA (1W: +8.44% | 1M: +17.01%) ABOVE TREND — failure to hold recent gap-up week would warn of short-term stall. AAPL (1W: +4.70% | 1M: +12.60%) ABOVE TREND — hold 1M trend support for leadership confirmation. JPM (1W: -3.32% | 1M: -2.65%) BELOW TREND — a decisive weekly close below recent lows would deepen Financials’ weakness.

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
UNH (+80): UnitedHealth (1W: +3.04% | 1M: +23.81%) ABOVE TREND — earnings beat/guidance lift; price confirms sentiment. QCOM (+65): Qualcomm (1W: +23.77% | 1M: +71.50%) ABOVE TREND — CEO commentary on AI partnerships; sentiment confirmed by strong price action.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
PYPL (-45): PayPal (1W: -10.05% | 1M: -1.33%) BELOW TREND — negative headlines align with sharp 1W sell-off; sentiment confirmed. (Other bearish-name timeframes not in today's feed for cross-check; monitor those stories for follow-through.)

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with mixed style (no clear Growth vs Value leadership). AMD, INTC, QCOM, AAPL and UNH are showing relative strength (all ABOVE TREND where noted). Key risk: narrow tech leadership + weak 4/11 sector breadth and several large-cap divergences — news-driven moves (UNH positive, PYPL negative) warrant tactical monitoring.
